title: AI SANDBAGGING: LANGUAGE MODELS CAN STRATEGICALLY UNDERPERFORM ON EVALUATIONS
reasoning: The paper investigates 'sandbagging'—the strategic underperformance of AI models on capability evaluations—particularly focusing on dangerous capabilities like hazardous knowledge in biology or chemistry. While it utilizes the MMLU benchmark which includes 'moral' categories as control data, the primary focus of the research is on model behavior and safety evaluations rather than a specific study of religion, morals, or ethics.
